mapper.select: SELECT -- 对方用户ID IF(m.user_id = #{userId}, m.receiver_id, m.user_id) AS userId, -- 对方用户昵称 u.nick_name AS nickName, -- 最后一条消息内容（保留原有字段） m.message AS message, -- 核心修改：统计当前用户的未读消息数量 unread.unread_count AS unreadCount, -- 对方用户头像 u.avatar AS avatar, m.create_time AS createTime FROM ( -- 第一步：获取每个对话的唯一标识和最后一条消息的时间 SELECT IF(user_id < receiver_id, CONCAT(user_id, '_', receiver_id), CONCAT(receiver_id, '_', user_id)) AS conversation_key, MAX(create_time) AS last_create_time FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY conversation_key ) AS temp -- 关联原message表获取最后一条消息的详情 INNER JOIN message m ON (m.user_id = #{userId} OR m.receiver_id = #{userId}) AND IF(m.user_id < m.receiver_id, CONCAT(m.user_id, '_', m.receiver_id), CONCAT(receiver_id, '_', m.user_id)) = temp.conversation_key AND m.create_time = temp.last_create_time -- 关联用户表获取对方用户信息 INNER JOIN user u ON IF(m.user_id = #{userId}, m.receiver_id, m.user_id) = u.user_id -- 核心新增：子查询统计每个对话的未读消息数 INNER JOIN ( SELECT -- 生成和外层一致的对话唯一标识 IF(user_id < receiver_id, CONCAT(user_id, '_', receiver_id), CONCAT(receiver_id, '_', user_id)) AS conversation_key, -- 统计当前用户收到的、未读的消息数量（假设status=0代表未读） COUNT(CASE WHEN receiver_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS unread_count FROM message WHERE user_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY conversation_key ) AS unread ON unread.conversation_key = temp.conversation_key -- 按最后一条消息时间倒序排列 ORDER BY m.create_time DESC;
